checks.label: Actor is the represented information source
Delivery names the represented information
Delivery names the represented recipient
Delivery channel agrees with information channel
Information is not active yet
Delivery is pending

limits: Delivery is represented, not a claim that the message caused a later decision.
mechanics.rationale: A represented member may deliver one represented information item through its declared delivery record to its declared recipient.
tests: only the declared source can deliver; recipient visibility remains actor-scoped

checks.label: the partnership is organizing the meeting
the organizer is the collective decision-making body

right.literal: Collective decision-making body responsible for the activation decision.

checks.label: the selected meeting is the regular member meeting
a new weekly meeting occurrence is available
deliberation has room to advance
time remains before the deadline

limits: Each represented weekly occurrence can support only one meeting under this progress record.
The meeting advances deliberation but does not itself authorize activation or manufacture member support.
Progress advances in twenty-point increments and is capped by the pre-action boundary at one hundred.
mechanics.rationale: The partnership can use an occurrence of the represented weekly meeting to advance deliberation while time remains before the deadline.
semantic_bindings: moment occurrences represent available weekly meetings
meeting progress represents deliberation toward a decision
meetings_delayed tracks consumed weekly meeting occurrences
tests: The partnership can hold the first meeting after the first weekly occurrence.
A member country cannot substitute for the collective organizer.
The same weekly occurrence cannot be counted twice.
A meeting is refused when no time remains or progress is already above eighty.

checks.label: the requester is making the request
the requester is aware of a represented concern
enough deliberation has occurred to revisit an issue

limits: The issue and concern must use the governed vocabulary.
Awareness establishes that a concern was received but does not encode a one-to-one mapping between each concern string and requester.
The model does not retain the identity of each reopened issue, so repeated reopening requests are not deduplicated.
mechanics.rationale: An aware member may reopen a previously considered issue, increasing the represented reopening count and consuming accumulated deliberation progress.
semantic_bindings: awareness represents receipt of a concern
settled_issues_reopened counts renewed issues
reconsideration consumes meeting progress
tests: An aware member with at least ten progress points can reopen an allowed issue.
An unaware requester is refused.
A requester cannot act on behalf of another member.
A reopening that would drive progress below zero is refused.

checks.label: the member is changing its own position
the member is aware of a represented concern
the member has not given full approval
fewer than five represented members are conditionally supportive

limits: The concern must use the governed concern vocabulary.
The aggregate count records conditional support, but represented state does not provide a dynamic per-member field that this single mechanic can select.

Because identity-specific conditional markers are absent, repeated declarations by one member cannot be distinguished from declarations by different members; the count is conservatively capped at five.
This action never grants full approval.
mechanics.rationale: An aware member may withhold full approval pending an allowed concern and increase the aggregate represented count of conditional supporters.
semantic_bindings: member awareness grounds the pending concern
lack of approval represents withholding unconditional approval
conditional_support_count aggregates conditional positions
tests: An aware member without full approval can add one conditional-support declaration.
An unaware member is refused.
A member cannot change another member's position.
A sixth aggregate conditional-support declaration is refused.

checks.label: the partnership is making the decision
the decision maker is the collective decision-making body

right.literal: Collective decision-making body responsible for the activation decision.

checks.label: the activation decision is pending
time remains before the deadline
the system has not been deployed
deployment has not been formally blocked

limits: The reason must identify insufficient deliberation, readiness, or support.
The reason text is governed but is not independently persisted after the action.
Delay does not block deployment permanently and does not create additional deadline time.
mechanics.rationale: While the activation decision remains pending and time remains, the collective decision-making body may postpone activation for an allowed insufficiency reason without deploying.
semantic_bindings: delayed decision status represents postponement
postponed deployment status prevents immediate deployment
meetings_delayed records additional deliberative delay
tests: The partnership can postpone a pending, undeployed activation while time remains.
A member country cannot make the collective postponement.
A decision that is already delayed, activated, or blocked cannot be delayed again.
Delay is refused after time has run out or after deployment.

checks.label: the partnership is making the decision
the decision maker is the collective decision-making body

right.literal: Collective decision-making body responsible for the activation decision.

checks.label: the decision deadline has occurred
activation has not been authorized
Country One has not supplied required support
the system has not been deployed
deployment is not already blocked

limits: This conservative rule proves absent support through Country One's represented position.
Readiness-only blocking is omitted because the action contract cannot express an OR between missing support and missing readiness without incorrectly requiring both.
Blocking is available only after the scheduled deadline occurrence and before deployment.
mechanics.rationale: Once the represented deadline has occurred, the partnership may formally block an undeployed system when at least one required member support position remains absent.
semantic_bindings: deadline occurrence establishes the blocking boundary
non-supportive member state establishes absent required support
deployment_blocked records the formal prohibition
tests: The partnership can block after the deadline when Country One is not supportive.
Blocking before the deadline is refused.
A member country cannot issue the collective block.
An already deployed or already blocked system cannot be blocked again.

checks.label: the partnership is making the decision
the deadline has not occurred
the activation decision is pending
Country One supports activation
Country Two supports activation
Country Three supports activation
Country Four supports activation
the Regional Health Network supports activation
technical readiness is complete
legal readiness is complete
logistics readiness is complete
community readiness is complete

limits: All five represented support positions and all four readiness dimensions are required.
The supplied support and readiness references are category-constrained to the unique represented state records.

The provided actions do not include a general way to turn undecided positions into supportive positions, so deployment requires those represented positions to be established by another governed transition or initial-state revision.
Activation after the deadline or from a non-pending decision is refused.
mechanics.rationale: The partnership may activate and deploy before the deadline only when every represented member is supportive and every represented readiness dimension is true.
semantic_bindings: unanimous represented support is sufficient support
four true readiness dimensions are sufficient readiness
activated decision and deployed status record authorization and deployment
tests: The partnership can deploy when all support positions are supportive, all readiness dimensions are true, the decision is pending, and the deadline has not occurred.
Any undecided or conditional member position prevents deployment.
Any false readiness dimension prevents deployment.
Deployment at or after the deadline occurrence is refused.

checks.label: the partnership is convening its own meeting
the organizer is the collective decision-making body

right.literal: Collective decision-making body responsible for the activation decision.

checks.label: the technical concern reached its member
the technical concern used the technical group channel
the legal concern reached its member
the legal concern used the legal group channel
the logistics concern reached its member
the logistics concern used the logistics group channel
the community concern reached its member
the community concern used the community group channel
initial structured deliberation has not begun
time remains before the deadline

limits: The four delivered channel records ground the represented concerns, but attendance and concern text are not separately persisted.
The meeting makes the four directly affected countries conditional; it does not infer support from the Regional Health Network.
The meeting establishes deliberation progress but does not authorize, delay, block, or deploy the system.
The initial meeting is refused after deliberation progress has already begun or when no time remains.
mechanics.rationale: The collective partnership may convene a structured initial deliberation once the four represented concern channels have delivered their concerns, recording conditional positions and a path toward decision.
semantic_bindings: delivered channel records represent the four concerns available for structured review
conditional country positions represent identified conditions for support
twenty percent meeting progress represents an established path toward decision
tests: The partnership can convene the initial structured meeting after all four concern deliveries are complete and time remains.
A member country or specialist group cannot substitute for the collective organizer.
A pending or wrongly channeled concern delivery causes refusal.
One delivered concern cannot stand in for concerns from differently named channels.
A second initial structured meeting is refused once progress is no longer zero.
The meeting is refused after the deadline countdown reaches zero.
The meeting leaves the Regional Health Network undecided and does not deploy the system.

checks.label: the member is participating personally
the delivery was addressed to the member
the delivery carries the selected information
the information concerns legal readiness
the legal concern has reached the member
the member is aware of the concern
legal readiness is confirmed
the meeting recurs weekly
a weekly meeting occurrence is available
time remains before the deadline
the member has not already approved activation
deliberation has room for the member's contribution

limits: This rule covers delivered legal concerns whose represented legal readiness is confirmed.
Approval is recorded on the participating member and does not infer approval by another member.
The fixed member-support record has no general actor-to-country-field mapping, so this action does not rewrite a named country support field.
A member can make this contribution only once while its approval remains recorded.
mechanics.rationale: A member whose delivered local legal concern is available may use an available recurring meeting to review it and approve activation when represented legal readiness is confirmed.
semantic_bindings: a delivered legal concern and member awareness establish material available for review
legal_ready confirms the readiness condition considered by the member
member approval records the member's resulting support
ten progress points represent the member's contribution to meeting deliberation
tests: Country Two can review its delivered legal concern during an available weekly meeting and approve activation when legal readiness is true.
Any other member in the same represented situation is handled by the same rule.
A member cannot use a delivery addressed to another member.
A pending delivery or non-legal information is refused.
Participation is refused when legal readiness is false, no weekly occurrence is available, or the deadline has passed.
A member whose approval is already recorded cannot add deliberation progress again through this action.

limits: The concern must use the governed concern vocabulary and must match the delivered information topic.

Because no identity-specific conditional marker exists, repeated conditional statements by one member cannot be distinguished from statements by different members; the aggregate is capped at five.
The concrete resolution condition is expressed by the attempt but is not separately persisted.
Participation does not grant full approval or authorize deployment.
mechanics.rationale: A member may use an available recurring meeting to review its delivered local concern and record conditional rather than full support while time remains.
semantic_bindings: a delivered concern and member awareness establish material available for review
an available recurring meeting establishes the participation opportunity
lack of full approval and the aggregate count represent conditional support

tests: Country Three can review its delivered logistics concern during an available weekly meeting and state conditional support while time remains.
Any other member with a delivered matching concern is handled by the same rule.
A member cannot use a delivery addressed to another member or carrying different information.
A pending delivery, mismatched concern topic, or unaware member is refused.

limits: The concern and safeguards must use the governed vocabulary.
The safeguard proposal is expressed by the attempt but is not separately persisted.
The aggregate support record has no general member-to-country-field mapping, so this action does not rewrite a named country support field.
Because no identity-specific conditional marker exists, repeated proposals by one member cannot be distinguished from proposals by different members; the aggregate is capped at five.
The proposal does not grant full approval, establish acceptance of the safeguards, or authorize deployment.

safeguards: documented community-facing safeguards, consultation, and feedback procedures

mechanics.rationale: A member may use an available recurring meeting to propose documented safeguards addressing its delivered local concern and record conditional support while time remains.
semantic_bindings: a delivered concern and member awareness establish the issue addressed by the proposal
an available recurring meeting establishes the participation opportunity
the safeguard parameter represents the documented condition proposed by the member
lack of full approval and the aggregate count represent conditional support
ten progress points represent the proposal's contribution to meeting deliberation
tests: Country Four can propose documented community-facing safeguards during an available weekly meeting after receiving its community concern.
Any member with a delivered matching concern can make an allowed safeguard proposal under the same conditions.
A member cannot use a delivery addressed to another member or carrying different information.
A pending delivery, mismatched concern topic, or unaware member is refused.
The action is refused when no weekly occurrence is available, the deadline has passed, or deliberation would exceed one hundred.
A sixth aggregate conditional-support proposal is refused, and proposing safeguards never grants full approval.

checks.label: the coordinator is leading the alignment session
the technical concern has been delivered
the technical concern used the technical group channel
the legal concern has been delivered
the legal concern used the legal group channel
the logistics concern has been delivered
the logistics concern used the logistics group channel
the community concern has been delivered
the community concern used the community group channel
the Regional Health Network has not already recorded a position
time remains before the decision deadline

limits: The four delivered channel records represent the concerns gathered for shared review; no separate shared-register entity exists.
The accepted conditions and remainder plan are expressed by the attempt but are not independently persisted.
Named owners and individual deadlines cannot be stored because no represented assignment or per-condition deadline fields exist.
Conditional positions do not establish full approval, resolve the concerns, authorize activation, or deploy the system.
The Regional Health Network position prevents the same alignment session from being recorded repeatedly.

accepted_conditions: represented readiness conditions already confirmed can be accepted immediately
remainder_plan: technical, legal, logistics, and community groups own their remaining conditions through the decision deadline

mechanics.rationale: Any partnership member may coordinate an urgent alignment session after all four concern channels have delivered their concerns, recording five conditional positions and advancing deliberation while time remains.
semantic_bindings: the four delivered channel records represent the shared concern set
the action parameters represent immediately accepted conditions and the remainder plan
five conditional support positions represent the requested partnership-wide conditional alignment
twenty progress points represent the urgent session's contribution to deliberation
tests: The Regional Health Network can coordinate the session after all four correctly channeled concerns are delivered and time remains.
Any other partnership member in the same represented situation can coordinate the session.
A pending concern or a concern supplied through the wrong channel causes refusal.
The session is refused after the deadline or when adding twenty progress points would exceed one hundred.
A second session is refused after the Regional Health Network position becomes conditional.
The session records five conditional positions but does not grant full approval or deploy the system.

checks.label: the coordinator is leading the focused alignment
the technical concern has been delivered
the technical concern used the technical group channel
the legal concern has been delivered
the legal concern used the legal group channel
the logistics concern has been delivered
the logistics concern used the logistics group channel
the community concern has been delivered
the community concern used the community group channel
the Regional Health Network has not joined a partnership-wide alignment
time remains before the decision deadline
deliberation has room for the focused alignment

limits: The four delivered channel records ground the shared concern set, but no shared-register field exists to persist its text.
Risk grouping, named mitigation owners, time bounds, and activation conditions are expressed by the attempt but cannot be stored separately.
The resulting positions are conditional and do not prove that mitigations were completed or conditions accepted.
The alignment does not grant full approval, authorize activation, or deploy the system.
The Regional Health Network position prevents the same partnership-wide alignment from being recorded repeatedly.

activation_conditions: activate only when the agreed technical, legal, logistics, and community conditions are satisfied
mitigation_assignments: assign each specialist group its corresponding mitigation through the decision deadline
risk_grouping: group concerns by technical, legal, logistics, and community decision risk
shared_register: one shared register containing the technical, legal, logistics, and community concerns

mechanics.rationale: Any partnership actor may organize the four delivered concern streams into a focused alignment attempt that records partnership-wide conditional support and advances deliberation before the deadline.
semantic_bindings: the four delivered channel records represent the concerns collected into the shared review
the action parameters represent the register, risk grouping, mitigation assignments, and common activation conditions
five conditional positions represent partnership-wide agreement to deliberate under those conditions
twenty progress points represent the focused alignment's contribution to deliberation
tests: The Regional Health Network can lead the focused alignment after all four correctly channeled concerns are delivered and time remains.
Any other partnership actor in the same represented situation can lead the same alignment.
A pending concern or a concern delivered through the wrong channel causes refusal.
The alignment is refused after the deadline or when adding twenty progress points would exceed one hundred.
A repeated alignment is refused after the Regional Health Network position becomes conditional.
The alignment records five conditional positions but does not record completed mitigations, full approval, or deployment.

checks.label: the moment is still ahead

processes.rationale: A scheduled moment's countdown falls by one each tick.

checks.label: the moment is due

processes.rationale: At zero the moment happens once, then restarts its countdown.

checks.label: at least one week remains

processes.rationale: Each round consumes one represented week while positive time remains.

checks.label: the current planning horizon has ended

processes.rationale: Because the world is ongoing, an exhausted planning horizon starts a new eight-week cycle and advances the represented deadline tick.

checks.label: the deliberation cycle is complete

processes.rationale: Completing a full deliberation cycle opens a fresh cycle in the ongoing world and clears cycle-specific reopening and meeting counters.
